says: A person selects two places in the checkout /home/ana/work of repository W: docs/adr (required, permitting local processing, no kept prompt log and W as the only destination) and README.md (optional, permitting nothing). source.observe reads only files under those two roots and writes nothing. A selection whose root climbs out of the checkout into a neighbouring repository (../neighbouring-repository/docs) is refused at admission and nothing is read. A selection whose required root docs/decisions is absent returns an observation that lists that root as missing, with ref_unavailable at /roots/0, instead of an empty read. With the checkout bound and a decisions source registered, its revision is committed declaring the neighbouring repository V's notes source as the companion its members are read with. A capture of an ADR the observation read is stored as a draft. Captures that name the same observation but claim input from records 12 to 18 of a session transcript nobody selected, from a file in V's own checkout, or from the hidden companion file docs/adr-notes/0001-journal-mode.notes.md beside the selected directory are each refused with input_not_observed at /processing/inputs/0, and nothing is stored. Resolving V's companion revision is refused with ref_unavailable: declaring a companion does not read it. No step reads a path, repository, transcript or companion outside what the person selected.
